data.one_liner: Flutter widgets and components for liquid glass morphism UI effects
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive collection of UI components styled with glassmorphism, including buttons, app bars, bottom bars, sheets, and switches. It supports adjustable blur, thickness, and standalone or grouped glass layers.
use_when: You want to implement a glassmorphism or liquid glass UI design across your Flutter app.
You need pre-built widgets like glass app bars, bottom navigation bars, sheets, and switches.
avoid_when: Your application requires a traditional Material Design or Cupertino look without heavy glass transparency effects.
Performance on very low-end devices is a strict priority and advanced blur/thickness rendering is unfeasible.
strengths: Comprehensive set of ready-to-use glass widgets (buttons, cards, inputs, navigation bars).
Supports both grouped glass layers and independent standalone containers.
Customizable blur, thickness, and quality presets (standard and premium).
weaknesses: Relies on external rendering packages which may impact performance on older hardware.
data.setup_notes: Wrap your app with LiquidGlassLayer and include the required dependencies in pubspec.yaml.
data.minimal_example:
LiquidGlassLayer(
  settings: const LiquidGlassSettings(
    thickness: 30,
    blur: 30,
  ),
  child: YourAppContent(),
)
